before: With w:balanceSingleByteDoubleByteWidth, a space in a run with character spacing or scaling keeps its own advance.
after: With w:balanceSingleByteDoubleByteWidth, a space beside East Asian text in a run with character spacing or scaling takes the scaled balanced width plus twice the spacing.
reason: Only derived layout changes. Shared nodes, canonical UTF-16 offsets, operations, and package serialization remain unchanged. Peers with the same fonts lay out the same lines.
